summary:
Verified on the current build (HEAD 09d330c0; nothing under src/ or content/ has changed since the reviewer's run). Combat feel & VFX scores 7.5/10. It is NOT on par: one major is open (C1, signature colour lost on third abilities and ultimates), and I confirmed it independently.

I re-ran the reviewer's a3/ult colour test with a decomposition probe (a copy of probe_kit_hue: a3/ult, a +30-frame window, and each cast repeated with team colour blacked out and with signature/secondary blacked out). It fails the same 18 of 32 slots, 9 of them ultimates. It also shows the cause per slot:
- Team (HARM) light is 44-92 % of the added VFX light on Dunsom a3/ult, Hesmi a3, Burdam ult, Nurrow ult and Rishal a3.
- Kemdo a3 passes only because team orange sits next to its salmon hue. With team colour removed, its signature share falls from 0.91 to 0.06, so it is a false pass.
- Tunlan, Ilsheta, Hesmi's ult, Vashil, Ervet a3 and Rishal ult are carried by fixed warm-white, Dawnglass or ice neutrals; their signature-keyed layers add about 0 % of the light.
- Content layer counts meet r12's spec on every slot (team 0-22 % of emissive layers). The defect is the share of light in play, not the layer count.

The two minors reproduced:
- C2: Hesmi's Felled Shard leaves the struck body 0.826 white in the full frame, and the first-beat core is x2.25 (< 2.3).
- C3: the basic-hit impact disc stays >= 0.5 x victim height for 3 / 2 / 5 frames (Kemdo / Rishal / Tunlan). The probe's own hold gate now FAILs on Rishal (100 ms < 200).

Content checks confirm: 0 shake layers, 48/48 timed casts with a wind-up VFX, and every delayed area has castTime + delay >= 0.6 s.

No regression and no missed blocker found in this lens. The greatwick crown-lamps are being reviewed by the closing originality lens (closing_originality_greatwick_* shots).

findings.title: Ultimates and third abilities lose the fighter's signature in play: 18/32 a3/ult slots read as team orange or as shared white/glass neutrals
findings.what:
Confirmed and refined.

The a1/a2 colour gate passes on every slot, but a3 and ult were never gated. In play, 18 of 32 a3/ult slots fail the same >= 0.5 signature-share metric, 9 of them ultimates. A 19th, Kemdo a3, is a false pass.

Two causes:
- **Team light dominates** (Dunsom a3/ult, Hesmi a3, Burdam a3/ult, Nurrow ult, Rishal a3, Ervet ult, Kemdo a3). A few team-keyed layers (an emissive-10 shockwave ring, the Long Glint decals, Hesmi a3's pillar) carry 36-95 % of the light the VFX add.
- **Fixed neutrals carry the effect** (Tunlan a3/ult, Ilsheta a3/ult, Hesmi ult, Vashil a3/ult, Ervet a3, Rishal ult, Ardit a3). Warm white/cream (#F3E3C2, #F7EBD0), Dawnglass #BFD3E6 or ice #B6CEE0 do the work, and the signature-keyed layers (often gradient tails such as "#BFD3E6" → "signature") add about 0 % of the light.

The content layer counts meet r12's M12 spec on every slot (team 0-22 % of emissive layers, signature mostly >= 50 %). The defect is the share of light in play, not authoring counts.

Reviewer wording corrected:
- Tunlan's ult is not 'orange rims'. The orange in that shot is the enemy cone telegraph, a legitimate indicator; the effect itself is about 10 % team light and about 48 % white/cream.
- Ilsheta's help effects are mainly warm white (0.49-0.57 white), with team at 16-21 % of the light.

findings.gauge:
r12 M12 (C1, R1): every champion owns a signature hue that survives in play, including on the ultimate. Hit sparks share a warm white. Team colour lives in indicators, rings and rims, not in the body of the effect.

The gauge statement is accurate. VALE now meets it on a1/a2 but not on 18-19 of 32 a3/ult slots, and the ultimate is where a League player identifies a champion fastest.

findings.title: Basic-attack impacts read large for only 67-167 ms
findings.what: Reproduced. The impact body is large on its first 2-3 frames and then contracts. Kemdo and Rishal fall short of the about-200 ms gauge; Tunlan's magic hit reaches 167 ms.
findings.evidence:
Verifier re-run (_harness/_reports/fw_W1_combat_polish_closing_combat_verify.json `hold`), disc diameter / victim height from the hit:
- Kemdo 1.11, 0.89, 0.55, 0.47 → 3 frames (100 ms).
- Rishal 0.88, 0.66, 0.36 → 2 frames (67 ms).
- Tunlan 0.98, 0.97, 0.79, 0.59, 0.50, 0.35 → 5 frames (167 ms).

The probe's own reach gate now FAILs on Rishal: 'the impact reaches >= 0.5 x the victim for 100 ms < 200'. The reviewer's run showed 300 ms. Reviewer's report: closing_combat_polish.json `hold.eqd`.
findings.gauge: r12 M5 (C1, V4): an impact starburst of about 0.7 x victim height held for about 200 ms, and a victim flash of 1-2 frames.
findings.fix: As the reviewer proposed: hold the mid-scale body of lib_hit_phys_light, lib_hit_phys_heavy and lib_hit_magic at >= 0.6 x victim height for 5-6 frames, then ease it out over 120 ms; heavy and crit hold for 7 frames. Switch the probe's hold gate to disc diameter >= 0.5 x for >= 167 ms, since reach is noisy run to run.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed minor. My numbers are slightly better for Tunlan (167 ms) and the same for Kemdo and Rishal. Timing, trails and the victim flash meet the gauge, so this is polish rather than a major.
